item.title: The hunt is on: 225 Easter eggs will be hidden across Central Arkansas
item.description: Starting March 14, 225 Easter eggs will be hidden in parks, public spaces, and popular community gathering spots within five miles of HealthCARE Express clinics in Sherwood, Maumelle, and Bryant.

item.title: One killed in quadruple shooting at Arkansas restaurant
item.description: One man was killed and three others were injured in a shooting at a Mexican restaurant in Osceola, Arkansas over the weekend, and police are investigating the cause.

item.title: TRAFFIC ALERT: Crash on Interstate-630 westbound stalls traffic
item.description: A crash on westbound Interstate 630 in Little Rock caused traffic delays Monday evening near Exit 4.

item.title: Severe weather causes damage across parts of Arkansas including first tornado of the year
item.description: An EF-2 tornado struck Nevada County, Arkansas early Saturday, damaging six homes and injuring one person, while strong winds from the same weather system caused power outages and downed trees in Independence and Saline counties.

item.title: Arkansas LEARNS marks three years as governor proposes new funding for program
item.description: Arkansas leaders are marking three years since the Arkansas LEARNS education overhaul was signed into law, as Gov. Sarah Huckabee Sanders proposes new funding to expand the program in the state’s upcoming budget.

item.title: Former home daycare operator in Pulaski County pleading not guilty to capital murder charge
item.description: PULASKI COUNTY, Ark. – On Monday, a plea and arraignment hearing for Erin Sauls, 23, on a capital murder charge ended in scheduling a bond hearing for June 5. item.title: North Little Rock police identify victim in Magnolia Street homicide
item.description: North Little Rock police have identified the man killed in an overnight shooting last week.

item.title: Exclusive first look at new North Little Rock Event Center
item.description: An idea North Little Rock Mayor Terry Hartwick says he's had for over a decade has come to life. From bright lights to ample seating, the stage is set for a venue that the mayor hopes will become a cornerstone of the city.

item.title: Traffic Alert: Banana Ball weekend in North Little Rock
item.description: The Banana Ball Championship League is bringing two games to CHI St. Vincent Field at Dickey-Stephens Park this weekend, resulting in heavy traffic and delays in downtown North Little Rock due to multiple overlapping events, including the 25th Annual St. Patrick's Day Parade and a Chicago concert at Simmons Bank Arena.

item.title: Locals react to fight after basketball game at Poyen High School
item.description: The Grant County Sheriff's Office has opened a criminal investigation after a fight broke out following a high school basketball playoff game Saturday night.
